vision.name: Blue Resourceful Mastery
vision.text:
[Continuous]: Your attacks deal +1 stage. Your Styled attacks without "anger" printed in the text-box gain "HIT: Raise or lower your opponent's anger 1."
[Instant] POWER: Use when your opponent's MP changes levels from one of your cards or effects. Draw a card.
POWER: Discard a Styled card from your hand to perform a non-Styled physical attack dealing 3 stages of damage. If you discarded a Setup or Drill that can perform an attack, you may place it into play instead.
vision.note: portrait Mastery layout; P number printed; title read from a crop of the original
